sections.text_helper: Section 28.4.9 "XSPI operating modes introduction" in chapter 28 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1311.
sections.section_content:
The XSPI has the following operating modes regardless of the low-level protocol used
(either regular-command or HyperBus):
• indirect mode (read or write)
• automatic status-polling mode (only in regular-command protocol)
• memory-mapped mode
